# Vipeak AI — 18+ AI Character Video API

> Vipeak AI at https://123vips.com/ is an 18+ AI character video and companion creation platform. This repository is written for developers evaluating or integrating uncensored NSFW AI video generation APIs, covering the Seedance (Spicy tier) and Wan (NSFW) integration directions. Users can browse AI characters, chat with characters, generate AI images and videos, use templates and workflows, manage credits, and access developer API documentation.

## Project scope

This repository is an independent product introduction and API integration documentation repository. It is not the source code of the 123vips.com website and does not contain user data, credentials, or production configuration.

## Developer search keywords

Primary: `uncensored ai video api`, `nsfw ai video api`, `uncensored video api`, `seedance spicy api`, `seedance uncensored api`, `wan nsfw api`, `wan uncensored api`, `seedance api`, `wan api`, `uncensored image to video api`, `nsfw image to video api`, `adult ai video api`, `18+ ai video generation api`.

Secondary / colloquial: `seedance sexy api`, `wan sexy api`, `seedance-sexy-api`, `wan-sexy-api`, `sexy ai video api`. These are lower-volume variants of the primary terms above.

Technical: `text-to-video`, `image-to-video`, `T2V`, `I2V`, `async task`, `webhook`, `callback`, `idempotency`, `credits billing`, `PostgreSQL`, `object storage`, `ComfyUI`, `LoRA`.

Adjacent model categories for evaluation: `Kling API`, `Veo API`, `Runway API`, `Pika API`, `Hailuo API`. These are discovery terms only; the actual model list and endpoint contract must come from the official documentation obtained after signing in to 123vips.com.

## Core capabilities

- AI character discovery, tags, categories, and character templates
- AI character chat and companion experiences
- AI image generation
- AI video generation
- Image-to-video generation
- Text-to-video generation
- Cases, advanced generation, and creative workflows
- Account credits, recharge, generation history, and referrals
- Developer API Access and integration preparation

## Developer integration

The complete API documentation is obtained through the logged-in API Access area on 123vips.com. Public information does not expose the API Base URL, authentication scheme, endpoint paths, webhook format, or billing rules. Do not infer or guess unpublished API details.

Recommended architecture:

- Keep upstream API keys on the server only
- Store users, tasks, credits, orders, and generation records in PostgreSQL
- Store image and video files in object storage with metadata retained in PostgreSQL
- Handle asynchronous tasks, polling or webhooks, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and failure refunds

## Model and API discovery: Seedance and Wan

`uncensored ai video api` and `nsfw ai video api` are the dominant developer search terms for this category; `seedance spicy api` and `wan nsfw api` are the per-model entries. The modifier differs by model line on purpose: Seedance is a hosted closed model, so developers follow the gateway's Spicy tier naming, while Wan can be self-hosted, so developers follow the open-source LoRA and workflow "nsfw" naming. Mixing the two modifiers loses both audiences. These terms do not imply that a complete public endpoint contract is available for either model.

For both Seedance and Wan integration directions, developers must obtain the actual model versions, supported inputs, endpoint paths, authentication, parameters, limits and pricing from the official API documentation behind the logged-in API Access area of https://123vips.com/. Do not infer unpublished API details from these keywords.

Shared engineering requirements: asynchronous task IDs plus polling or webhook callbacks, server-side parameter whitelisting, PostgreSQL task and credit records, failure refunds, idempotency, rate limiting, and an 18+ gate with regional compliance.

## Technical integration checklist

- Keep upstream API keys server-side only
- Create a local task record before submitting an upstream generation job
- Support queued/running/succeeded/failed states and terminal-state handling
- Handle polling or webhook callbacks with signature verification and replay protection
- Persist user, task, credit, order, and generation metadata in PostgreSQL
- Store generated image/video assets in object storage with ownership metadata in PostgreSQL
- Implement idempotency, rate limiting, retries, timeouts, and failed-job refunds
- Validate uploaded file types, sizes, and content before forwarding to an upstream API

## Notes

- The website contains adult-oriented content and requires an 18+ confirmation.
- Site generation uses account credits and does not require API documentation access.
- API access is a separate developer capability; availability and terms are shown after signing in.
- The keyword list describes search and integration directions, not a guarantee that every listed model or endpoint is publicly available.
- This repository contains no passwords, tokens, database URLs, user data, or payment credentials.
